title: Kubernaut Helm Chart Values
description: Schema for validating Kubernaut Helm chart values.yaml

k8sLabelSelector.description: A Kubernetes LabelSelector (matchLabels/matchExpressions), used as a raw namespaceSelector value in a NetworkPolicy ingress peer.

ingressCIDRs.description: CIDR blocks allowed as ingress sources (ipBlock). Required for traffic not associated with any pod/namespace -- e.g. NodePort-sourced host traffic (SNAT'd to the node's own IP) or a hostNetwork-mode ingress controller/router -- since podSelector/namespaceSelector can never match non-pod-associated source IPs (Issue #1737).

ingressNamespaceSelectors.description: Raw namespaceSelector label selectors allowed as ingress sources, for cases the simple name-based ingressNamespaces list cannot express.

httpIngress.description: A networking.k8s.io/v1 Ingress for external access to a service. Opt-in and disabled by default (BR-PLATFORM-009, Kubernaut Operator parity with Gateway/APIFrontend/Console Route resources) -- each of these is either a machine-facing pipeline entry point or optional/replaceable UI tooling, so external exposure is a deliberate per-service choice, not a default.

host.description: Hostname for external access. Leaving this empty renders a catch-all Ingress rule.

secretName.description: Pre-created Secret with a TLS cert for `host`; omit for HTTP-only or an ingress controller that provides its own default cert

autoscaling.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler (BR-PLATFORM-003, Issue #1589). autoscaling/v2 is a stable core API — no CRD required.

enabled.description: Create a HorizontalPodAutoscaler for this service

memoryTarget.description: Target average memory utilization percentage (0 disables the memory metric)

fleetOAuth2.description: OAuth2 client credentials for MCP Gateway authentication (ADR-068)

credentialsSecretRef.description: K8s Secret with keys: client-id, client-secret

tlsCAFile.description: Path to a CA bundle for verifying tokenURL's TLS certificate; defaults to the shared inter-service CA when empty

fleetOAuth2CredentialsOverride.description: Per-service OAuth2 credentials override (Issue #1707 follow-up): every other fleet.oauth2 field moved to global.fleet.oauth2 -- only credentialsSecretRef remains overridable per service.

credentialsSecretRef.description: K8s Secret with keys: client-id, client-secret. Overrides global.fleet.oauth2.credentialsSecretRef for this service only.

nodePort.description: SPIKE (Issue #1737): pin an explicit NodePort for the service's primary port when type=NodePort (must be in the 30000-32767 range per Kubernetes' default --service-node-port-range). 0 (default) preserves existing behavior -- Kubernetes auto-assigns a port. Intended for test/CI environments that need a deterministic, host-accessible port; production deployments should generally leave this unset and use an Ingress/Gateway instead.

pdb.description: PodDisruptionBudget configuration. DD-PLATFORM-004: enabled by default (maxUnavailable: 1) for all services that render a PDB (see templates/pdb.yaml); minAvailable is intentionally not the default because it blocks all voluntary disruption at replicas=1 (PodDisruptionBudgetAtLimit).

tolerations.description: Pod tolerations (overrides global.tolerations for this component)

serviceLogging.description: Structured logging level for service ConfigMap (Issue #875)

global.description: Global settings applied across all components

registry.description: Container image registry hostname (e.g. quay.io, harbor.corp, image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000/ns)

namespace.description: Image namespace prefix. Joined to service name by separator.

separator.description: Character joining namespace to service name. Use '/' for nested registries (Harbor, Artifactory), '-' for flat registries (quay.io, Docker Hub).

tag.description: Image tag; empty defaults to Chart.appVersion

digest.description: Image digest (e.g. sha256:abc...); when set, overrides tag for immutable references

imagePullSecrets.description: List of image pull secret names for private registries

enabled.description: Multi-cluster fleet federation on/off (Issue #1707), consolidated from four independent per-service toggles (gateway/remediationorchestrator/apifrontend/effectivenessmonitor fleet.enabled)

backend.description: Backend adapter for GW/RO's federated scope-check: fleetmetadatacache (FMC HTTP API) or acm (ACM Search). Defaults to fleetmetadatacache when empty.

endpoint.description: Endpoint for the selected backend. Auto-derived for fleetmetadatacache; required for acm.

mcpGatewayEndpoint.description: Shared MCP Gateway endpoint URL, used by every fleet-integration-capable service (Issue #1707 follow-up: global-only, no per-service override).

mcpGatewayType.description: Shared MCP Gateway type (eaigw or kuadrant), used by every fleet-integration-capable service (Issue #1707 follow-up: global-only, no per-service override).

tlsCAFile.description: Shared CA bundle path for verifying the MCP Gateway's TLS certificate, used by every fleet-integration-capable service (Issue #1707 follow-up: global-only, no per-service override).

tokenSecretRef.description: K8s Secret (key: token) with a bearer token for authenticating to the ACM Search GraphQL API (backend=acm). Mandatory when backend=acm; FleetConfig.Validate() rejects backend=acm without it (#1556).

enabled.description: OAuth2 client_credentials auth on/off for MCP Gateway authentication (Issue #1707 follow-up: global-only, no per-service override).

tokenURL.description: Shared OAuth2 token URL for MCP Gateway authentication, used by every fleet-integration-capable service (Issue #1707 follow-up: global-only, no per-service override).

credentialsSecretRef.description: Shared Secret name (keys: client-id, client-secret) for MCP Gateway OAuth2, used as the fallback when a service's own fleet.oauth2.credentialsSecretRef is unset (the one field that remains overridable per service).

scopes.description: Shared OAuth2 scopes for MCP Gateway authentication, used by every fleet-integration-capable service (Issue #1707 follow-up: global-only, no per-service override).

tlsCAFile.description: Shared CA bundle path for verifying tokenURL's TLS certificate, used by every fleet-integration-capable service (Issue #1707 follow-up: global-only, no per-service override).

llmProfiles.description: Named LLM provider profiles, referenced by name from kubernautAgent.llmProfileRef, kubernautAgent.phaseModels, kubernautAgent.alignmentCheck.llmProfileRef, apifrontend.llmProfileRef, and apifrontend.config.severityTriage.llmProfileRef (DD-PLATFORM-007). Mirrors the Kubernaut Operator's spec.llmProfiles authoring model -- a profile defined once is reusable by any consumer without re-deriving its field set.

provider.description: LLM provider name. NOT currently supported: bedrock (tracked in #1582). For Mistral/Ollama/HuggingFace TGI/self-hosted vLLM or LlamaStack, use 'openai_compatible' with `endpoint` set. For Azure OpenAI, use 'openai' or 'openai_compatible' with `azureApiVersion` set (#1600) -- there is no dedicated 'azure' provider value. 'vertex_ai' hosts either Claude or Gemini models depending on `model` (#1778, #1792) -- both KA and AF auto-detect which client to construct from the model name prefix (`claude-*` vs `gemini-*`).

model.description: LLM model name (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-20250514, gemini-2.5-pro).

credentialsSecretName.description: Name of the pre-existing K8s Secret containing this profile's LLM API credentials.

endpoint.description: LLM endpoint URL override. Empty uses the provider default.

temperature.description: LLM sampling temperature. Omitted by default (#1749) -- some models (e.g. claude-opus-4-8) reject this parameter outright with a 400 if it is present at all. Only set this if your model supports it.

vertexProject.description: GCP project ID. Required for vertex_ai provider.

vertexLocation.description: GCP region (e.g. us-central1). Required for vertex_ai provider.

azureApiVersion.description: Azure OpenAI API version (e.g. 2024-10-21). Set alongside provider: openai/openai_compatible to switch to Azure's deployment-scoped URL and api-key auth (#1600); `model` doubles as the Azure deployment ID.

tlsCaFile.description: Path to PEM CA cert for internal LLM endpoints behind a private CA.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 client credentials grant for enterprise LLM gateway authentication.

enabled.description: Enable OAuth2 client credentials token acquisition for LLM requests.

tokenURL.description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL (e.g. Keycloak, Azure AD).

credentialsSecretRef.description: K8s Secret name containing client-id and client-secret keys.

reasoning.description: Model-aware reasoning/thinking token support (BR-AI-086). Disabled by default; opt-in only.

enabled.description: Request reasoning/thinking output from the model where the provider/model supports it.

budgetTokens.description: Max tokens the model may spend on reasoning/thinking (Anthropic extended thinking budget; also used as Gemini's thinkingBudget on Kubernaut Agent's Gemini-family client, BR-AI-087). 0 lets the provider/client choose a default.

effort.description: Unified, provider-agnostic reasoning-depth knob (#1604): empty lets the vendor/provider choose its own default. Anthropic and Gemini have no tier above "high", so "xhigh" is accepted but clamped down to "high" on those two providers (not an error).

capabilityOverride.description: Overrides vendor/model-name auto-detection of reasoning support. Only meaningful for self-hosted/custom models served via the openai_compatible provider.

podDefaults.description: DD-PLATFORM-006 Decision Area 1: cluster-wide pod-level defaults, overridable per-service. Currently covers pdb only -- affinity/podSecurityContext/nodeSelector/tolerations already have their own default mechanisms (see templates/_helpers.tpl) and topologySpreadConstraints has no default.

defaultResources.description: DD-PLATFORM-006 Decision Area 2: schema-declared fallback-of-last-resort, used only if a future service is added without its own explicit resources block. Every one of the 14 current services keeps its own workload-appropriate resources block -- this does NOT override any of them.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name in resource names

tls.description: TLS certificate management for AuthWebhook and inter-service communication.

mode.description: TLS mode: 'hook' (self-signed via Helm hooks), 'cert-manager' (production, requires cert-manager), or 'manual' (user-managed certificates)

name.description: Name of the Issuer or ClusterIssuer. Usually left empty when tls.mode=cert-manager: auto-selected via `lookup` if exactly one exists in the cluster. Set explicitly for helm template/GitOps rendering or when multiple issuers exist.

interService.description: Issue #678/#753: TLS for inter-service communication (Gateway, DataStorage) is unconditionally mandatory. Certs are generated by the tls-cert-job hook.

certDir.description: Directory containing tls.crt and tls.key for server-side TLS

caFile.description: Path to the CA certificate for client-side trust

gateway.description: Gateway service (AlertManager webhook target + external signal ingestion)

trustedProxyCIDRs.description: Issue #673 L-1: CIDRs whose proxy headers are trusted

cors.description: Issue #1215: CORS configuration (moved from env vars to config YAML)

allowedOrigins.description: Allowed CORS origins. M2M API — deny by default.

allowCredentials.description: Whether cross-origin requests may include credentials.

signalSources.description: External signal sources that need RBAC to call the Gateway

fleet.description: Multi-cluster fleet configuration (BR-INTEGRATION-065, ADR-068, DD-FLEET-003). On/off toggle consolidated into global.fleet.enabled (Issue #1707); backend/endpoint/mcpGatewayEndpoint/mcpGatewayType/tlsCAFile/tokenSecretRef/oauth2.{enabled,tokenURL,scopes,tlsCAFile} consolidated into global.fleet.* (Issue #1707 follow-up).

maxBodySize.description: #1048 Phase 4 / SC-5: Maximum request body size in bytes

signerCertDir.description: #1048 Phase 5 / AU-9: Directory containing signing cert (tls.crt, tls.key)

rateLimit.description: GAP-09 (Issue #1505) / SC-5: Per-IP rate limiting for the DS HTTP API. DD-PLATFORM-006 DA6: mandatory, no enabled gate.

dlqMaxLen.description: #1048 Phase 5 / AU-11: Redis DLQ MAXLEN bound

tls.description: #1048 Phase 5 / AU-9: Redis TLS client configuration. DD-PLATFORM-006 DA6: mandatory, no enabled gate.

caFile.description: CA bundle to verify Redis server

enabled.description: Enable periodic purge of expired audit events

interval.description: How often the retention worker runs

defaultDays.description: Application-level default retention in days (ADR-034: 7 years)

auditHashKey.description: GAP-05 (Issue #1505) / AU-9: keyed HMAC-SHA256 audit hash chain. DD-PLATFORM-006 DA6: mandatory, no enabled gate.

existingSecret.description: Pre-created Secret name; defaults to datastorage-audit-hmac-key when unset

secretKey.description: Key name within the secret's audit-hmac-key.yaml file

dbExistingSecret.description: DEPRECATED: db-secrets.yaml is now in postgresql-secret. Set only for BYO PostgreSQL with a separate DataStorage secret.

policies.description: Approval policy externalization. Provide content via --set-file or reference an existing ConfigMap.
Classification policy externalization (ADR-060). Provide content via --set-file or reference an existing ConfigMap.

content.description: Raw Rego policy content. Inject via --set-file signalprocessing.policies.content=policy.rego

existingConfigMap.description: Pre-existing ConfigMap with key 'policy.rego'. Mutually exclusive with 'content'.

fleet.description: Multi-cluster fleet configuration (BR-INTEGRATION-054/BR-FLEET-003, ADR-068). endpoint/mcpGatewayType consolidated into global.fleet.mcpGatewayEndpoint/mcpGatewayType (Issue #1707 follow-up) -- this also fixes a pre-existing gap where SP's own endpoint field had no global fallback at all.

namespace.description: Restricts the ClusterRegistry CRD watch; empty watches all namespaces

ineffectiveChainThreshold.description: Ineffective workflow chain length before escalation

stabilizationWindow.description: Time for system stabilization after remediation before assessment

gitOpsSyncDelay.description: Expected time for GitOps tool (ArgoCD/Flux) to sync changes to cluster

operatorReconcileDelay.description: Expected time for operator to reconcile after CR update

proactiveAlertDelay.description: Extra delay for proactive alert resolution

notifySelfResolved.description: Emit status-update notification when signal self-resolves (BR-ORCH-037 AC-037-08)

period.description: Duration before terminal RemediationRequests are cleaned up

fleet.description: Multi-cluster fleet configuration (BR-INTEGRATION-065, ADR-068, DD-FLEET-003). On/off toggle consolidated into global.fleet.enabled (Issue #1707); backend/endpoint/mcpGatewayEndpoint/mcpGatewayType/tlsCAFile/tokenSecretRef/oauth2.{enabled,tokenURL,scopes,tlsCAFile} consolidated into global.fleet.* (Issue #1707 follow-up).

tekton.description: Tekton Pipelines engine configuration (issue #868). Omit for auto-discovery.

enabled.description: true or omit = auto-discover CRDs; false = disable Tekton engine

ansible.description: AWX/AAP connectivity for the ansible executor (issue #478). Omit to disable.

apiURL.description: AWX/AAP API base URL (required when ansible is enabled)

tokenSecretRef.description: Reference to a K8s Secret containing the AWX API token

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret (empty = release namespace)

caCertSecretRef.description: BR-PLATFORM-005: reference to a K8s Secret containing a PEM-encoded CA certificate for the AAP/AWX API endpoint. Set when AAP/AWX uses a self-signed or private-CA certificate (Kubernaut Operator parity). If omitted, only the system trust store + inter-service CA are trusted.

key.description: Key within the Secret containing the PEM CA certificate

fleet.description: Multi-cluster fleet configuration for remote workflow execution (BR-FLEET-054, ADR-068). Endpoint/oauth2.{enabled,tokenURL,scopes,tlsCAFile} come from global.fleet.* -- no per-service override, since WE has no ClusterRegistry/CRD-watch capability (no mcpGatewayType, no namespace). oauth2.credentialsSecretRef is the one WE-owned, REQUIRED field: it does NOT fall back to global.fleet.oauth2.credentialsSecretRef, because WE is the only fleet-integration-capable service calling MCP write tools (resources_create_or_update/resources_delete) instead of the read-only tools every other service uses.

credentialsSecretRef.description: REQUIRED (no fallback to global.fleet.oauth2.credentialsSecretRef) when global.fleet.oauth2.enabled=true. K8s Secret (keys: client-id, client-secret) for a write-scoped OAuth2 client, distinct from the read-only credential shared by gateway/remediationorchestrator/apifrontend/effectivenessmonitor/signalprocessing/fleetmetadatacache.

slack.description: Slack quickstart shortcut. Auto-generates routing and credential projection when secretName is set.

secretName.description: K8s Secret containing Slack webhook URL. Empty = no Slack.

secretKey.description: Key within the Secret that holds the webhook URL.

routing.description: Notification routing externalization. Provide content via --set-file or reference an existing ConfigMap.

stabilizationWindow.description: Time to wait after remediation before assessing effectiveness

fleet.description: Multi-cluster fleet configuration (BR-FLEET-054, ADR-068). On/off toggle consolidated into global.fleet.enabled (Issue #1707); mcpGatewayEndpoint/mcpGatewayType/tlsCAFile/oauth2.{enabled,tokenURL,scopes,tlsCAFile} consolidated into global.fleet.* (Issue #1707 follow-up).

namespace.description: Restricts the ClusterRegistry CRD watch to a single namespace instead of cluster-wide (BR-RBAC-020, #1686). Empty (default) watches all namespaces and grants cluster-wide RBAC

llmProfileRef.description: Name of an entry in global.llmProfiles used for KA's investigator LLM calls (DD-PLATFORM-007). Defaults to "primary" (DD-PLATFORM-006 DA4); an undefined profile still fails the render. Replaces the old kubernautAgent.llm.* literal block.

phaseModels.description: Per-phase LLM profile overrides (DD-PLATFORM-007), newly exposed via Helm. Maps a phase name (rca, workflow_discovery, validation) to a profile name in global.llmProfiles; unlisted phases use kubernautAgent.llmProfileRef's profile unchanged.

alignmentCheck.description: Shadow agent alignment check (#601): parallel audit for prompt injection detection.

maxStepTokens.description: Max evaluator response tokens per step.

llmProfileRef.description: DD-PLATFORM-007: name of an entry in global.llmProfiles for a dedicated alignment-check shadow-agent LLM. Empty (default) inherits kubernautAgent.llmProfileRef's resolved profile, reusing the investigation LLM. Replaces the old alignmentCheck.llm.* block, whose apiKey field never had any effect (the Kubernaut Agent binary only reads apiKeyFile -- see kubernaut#1726 for the same class of bug).

interactive.description: MCP interactive mode (#703): enables human-in-the-loop investigation sessions.

enabled.description: Enable MCP interactive mode endpoint and Lease-based session management. DD-PLATFORM-006 Decision Area 11: requires apifrontend.enabled=true (APIFrontend's ka.NewSDKMCPClient is the only caller of this endpoint); the render fails otherwise.

sessionTTL.description: Maximum duration for an interactive session before auto-release.

maxConcurrentSessions.description: Maximum concurrent interactive sessions per instance. Issue #1737: raised from 5 to 50 -- the old default was too low even for realistic production use and caused full-suite E2E failures purely from Ginkgo's own test parallelism.

rateLimitPerUser.description: Maximum requests per second per authenticated user. Issue #1737: raised from 10 to 20, alongside maxConcurrentSessions.

maxAnalyzingTimeout.description: Extended analyzing timeout for RO when an interactive session is active. Prevents RO from timing out a RemediationRequest while an operator is investigating.

jwtProviders.description: JWT providers for Pattern B authentication (DD-AUTH-MCP-001 v2.0).

issuer.description: JWT issuer URL (must match iss claim).

jwksURL.description: JWKS endpoint URL for signature verification.

groups.description: JWT claim for groups extraction (supports dot-notation).

fleet.description: Multi-cluster fleet configuration (BR-FLEET-054, ADR-068, issue #1729). Gated by global.fleet.enabled -- when true, KA's investigator additionally advertises the fleet MCP Gateway's remote-cluster tools for fleet-tagged investigations, alongside its local kubectl_* tools. mcpGatewayEndpoint/mcpGatewayType/oauth2.{enabled,tokenURL,scopes} come from global.fleet.* (Issue #1707 follow-up); only oauth2.credentialsSecretRef remains overridable here. No namespace field (unlike apifrontend/effectivenessmonitor): KA has no ClusterRegistry informer/watch.

postgresql.description: PostgreSQL (DataStorage backend). Set enabled=false to use external host/port (BYO #256)

enabled.description: Set false to skip in-chart PostgreSQL and use external host/port instead

host.description: External PostgreSQL host. Required when enabled=false.

existingSecret.description: Pre-created Secret name with POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB, db-secrets.yaml keys. Empty = expect 'postgresql-secret'.

valkey.description: Valkey (DataStorage DLQ). Redis-compatible in-memory store. Set enabled=false to use external host/port (BYO #256)

enabled.description: Set false to skip in-chart Valkey and use external host/port instead

host.description: External Valkey host. Required when enabled=false.

existingSecret.description: Pre-created Secret name with valkey-secrets.yaml key. Empty = expect 'valkey-secret'.

fleetmetadatacache.description: FleetMetadataCache: Fleet Metadata Cache service (BR-INTEGRATION-065, ADR-068)

enabled.description: DD-PLATFORM-006 Decision Area 10: when unset, the effective value is derived from global.fleet.enabled + global.fleet.backend (true whenever the fleet backend resolves to "fleetmetadatacache"); set explicitly to override. An explicit false that contradicts a derived-true fails the render.

valkeyTLS.description: DD-PLATFORM-006 Decision Area 13 follow-up (round-16 RCA, PR #1790): TLS client configuration for FMC's Valkey connection (pkg/fleet/fmc.ValkeyWriter, pkg/fleet/scopecache.ValkeyCacheReader). Mandatory (no enabled gate) -- the chart's own Valkey is TLS-only (Decision Area 8), and unlike the APIFrontend replay cache this dependency has no fail-open fallback, so it must match DataStorage's config.redis.tls hardening rather than the replay cache's opt-in one.

certFile.description: Client certificate file path (mTLS) -- unused against the chart's own Valkey (no client cert required), available for BYO Valkey/Redis that requires mTLS

caFile.description: CA bundle to verify the Valkey server certificate. Defaults to the chart's distributed inter-service CA (/etc/tls-ca/ca.crt) when left empty; override only for a BYO Valkey/Redis signed by a different CA.

apifrontend.description: API Frontend (MCP bridge between users and Kubernaut Agent)

fleet.description: Multi-cluster fleet configuration (BR-FLEET-054, ADR-068). On/off toggle consolidated into global.fleet.enabled (Issue #1707); mcpGatewayEndpoint/mcpGatewayType/tlsCAFile/oauth2.{enabled,tokenURL,scopes,tlsCAFile} consolidated into global.fleet.* (Issue #1707 follow-up).

namespace.description: Restricts the ClusterRegistry CRD watch to a single namespace instead of cluster-wide (BR-RBAC-020, #1686). Empty (default) watches all namespaces and grants cluster-wide RBAC

llmProfileRef.description: DD-PLATFORM-007: name of an entry in global.llmProfiles for API Frontend's own agent-loop LLM connection. Empty (default) defaults to kubernautAgent.llmProfileRef's resolved profile, matching the Kubernaut Operator's AFLLMProfileRef fallback behavior. Newly exposed -- this Go capability (Config.Agent.LLM) existed but was previously unreachable via Helm.

mcp.description: AF's own /mcp protocol endpoint for external MCP clients (distinct from AF-as-a-client-of-KA's-MCP-server, which is always active). Issue #1737 gap found: never exposed via Helm, so this defaulted to disabled and every /mcp request returned 501 regardless of TLS/RBAC wiring.

interactive.description: Session-dependent A2A/MCP tool registration (kubernaut_investigate, discover_workflows, select_workflow, message, complete, cancel, status, reconnect, await_session). Config.DefaultConfig() already defaults this true; exposed here for override/documentation clarity, not a behavior-changing fix (unlike apifrontend.config.mcp.enabled, which defaults false).

llmProfileRef.description: DD-PLATFORM-007: name of an entry in global.llmProfiles for severity-triage's LLM fallback tiers, independent of API Frontend's own apifrontend.llmProfileRef connection. Empty (default) inherits API Frontend's own resolved profile, matching the Kubernaut Operator's APIFrontendSeverityTriageSpec.LLMProfileRef behavior. Newly exposed -- this Go capability (Config.SeverityTriage.LLM) existed but was previously unreachable via Helm. May reference a profile with a different provider/credentialsSecretName than API Frontend's own; the one exception is vertex_ai: when both resolve to vertex_ai, they must share credentialsSecretName (kubernaut#1731), enforced with a fail() guard.

llmEnabled.description: DD-PLATFORM-007: whether LLM-based severity-triage tiers are active. When false, no llm block is rendered, forcing rule-based-only triage -- independent of llmProfileRef and of severity triage as a whole. Matches the Kubernaut Operator's APIFrontendSeverityTriageSpec.LLMEnabled (default true).

issuerURL.description: OIDC issuer URL for JWT validation. When set, OIDC/JWKS auth is used. When empty, K8s TokenReview is auto-detected.

jwksURL.description: JWKS endpoint URL for the legacy single-provider issuerURL (optional, defaults to issuerURL's well-known discovery when empty)

oidcCaFile.description: Path to a CA bundle used when fetching JWKS from issuerURL over TLS with a private/self-signed CA (e.g. an in-cluster OIDC test double signed by the chart's own inter-service CA). Requires mounting that CA into the pod -- the chart does this automatically when this field is set (or when global.fleet.enabled is true).

allowInsecureIssuers.description: Allow http:// (non-TLS) issuerURL/jwksURL values. Dev/test only -- never set true in production (SC-8).

jwtProviders.description: Multi-provider JWT configuration (#1436). When set, takes precedence over issuerURL/audience.

issuerURL.description: OIDC issuer URL (must match JWT iss claim)

jwksURL.description: JWKS endpoint URL (optional, defaults to issuerURL)

username.description: Claim path or CEL expression for username

groups.description: Claim path or CEL expression for groups

replayCache.description: GAP-08 (Issue #1505): distributed jti replay-detection backend, shared across all APIFrontend replicas via the cluster's Valkey instance. Disabled by default (legacy in-memory, single-process cache) -- DD-PLATFORM-006 DA6 briefly made this mandatory, but reverted: jti-uniqueness-based replay detection rejects any second presentation of the same token within the cache TTL, which is exactly how a legitimate client is expected to reuse an OAuth2 Bearer token across multiple requests, so mandating it on breaks normal multi-call sessions, not just a multi-replica edge case.

redisDB.description: Valkey logical DB index used for replay cache keys

tls.description: DD-PLATFORM-006 DA9: TLS for the replay-cache Valkey connection. Required once the target Valkey is TLS-only (the chart's own bundled Valkey, per Decision Area 8's default).

enabled.description: Enable TLS for the replay-cache Valkey/Redis connection

certFile.description: Client certificate file path (mTLS) -- unused against the chart's own Valkey (no client cert required), available for BYO Redis that requires mTLS

caFile.description: CA bundle to verify the Valkey/Redis server certificate. Defaults to the chart's distributed inter-service CA (/etc/tls-ca/ca.crt) when left empty; override only for a BYO Valkey/Redis signed by a different CA.

rateLimit.description: Issue #1737 gap found: never wired into the chart, so AF silently ran with a package-level fallback of only 3 concurrent sessions / 60 tool calls per minute (cfg.RateLimit.MaxConcurrentSessions/ToolCallsPerMinute only override that fallback when > 0) -- too low for realistic concurrent MCP/A2A session load.

personas.description: Map of persona name to list of allowed tool names for SAR-based authorization

console.description: BR-PLATFORM-006: standalone web console (A2A chat UI), opt-in, Kubernaut Operator parity

secretName.description: Pre-created Secret with keys: client-id, client-secret, cookie-secret. Required when console.enabled=true.

extraSANs.description: PR #1790 round-14 RCA: extra DNS names added to every chart-issued inter-service leaf cert's SAN (gateway/datastorage/kubernaut-agent/fleetmetadatacache/apifrontend/valkey), alongside the standard in-cluster Service DNS names. 'IP:127.0.0.1' is added automatically whenever this is non-empty. Empty by default -- a real cluster is never accessed via localhost, so this has zero effect on production installs. Exists so host-based test/dev clients (e.g. `https://localhost:<nodePort>`) can pass full TLS hostname verification against the chart's own certs without a separate post-install re-sign+restart pass (which previously caused deterministic rollout timeouts under E2E's resource-constrained CI runners -- see resignHostAccessedTLSCertsWithLocalhostSAN's removal in test/infrastructure/fullpipeline_e2e.go).

enabled.description: Enable Prometheus integration for both EM and KA

tlsCaFile.description: Path to PEM CA bundle for HTTPS.
Path to PEM CA bundle for HTTPS.

serviceMonitor.description: ServiceMonitor resources for scraping each service's /metrics endpoint (BR-PLATFORM-003, Issue #1589). Requires monitoring.coreos.com/v1 CRD (kube-prometheus-stack) — no-op when absent, even if enabled=true. Not rendered for authwebhook (metrics intentionally disabled).

enabled.description: Create ServiceMonitor resources for all metrics-emitting services

prometheusRule.description: PrometheusRule resource for interactive session SLO alerting (Issue #1005), and for DataStorage/APIFrontend availability/latency/error alerting (BR-PLATFORM-003, Issue #1589)

enabled.description: Create PrometheusRule resources (interactive session SLOs, DataStorage/APIFrontend alerting)

additionalLabels.description: Additional labels for PrometheusRule (e.g. prometheus: kube-prometheus)

activeSessionsMax.description: Max concurrent interactive sessions before alerting

activeSessionsFor.description: Duration threshold must be exceeded before firing

commandDurationP99Max.description: Max p99 command duration in seconds

networkPolicies.description: NetworkPolicy configuration for all Kubernaut services (Issue #285)

apiServerCIDR.description: K8s API server real backend endpoint IP as a /32 CIDR (e.g., 10.89.0.2/32) -- NOT the 'kubernetes' Service ClusterIP, which most CNIs ignore for NetworkPolicy egress. Usually left empty: auto-discovered via `lookup` during a real helm install/upgrade. Set explicitly only for helm template/GitOps rendering, restricted-RBAC installers, or to override discovery. Use for single-control-plane clusters; use apiServerCIDRs for HA.

apiServerCIDRs.description: Additional K8s API server backend endpoint IPs as /32 CIDRs, for HA clusters with multiple control-plane nodes. Merged with apiServerCIDR. Usually left empty (see apiServerCIDR).

apiServerPort.description: Port the K8s API server's real backend endpoint(s) listen on (commonly 6443), not necessarily the 'kubernetes' Service's port (443). 0 means auto-discover via `lookup` (falls back to 443 if unavailable).

prometheusPort.description: Prometheus port to allow in the NetworkPolicy egress rule

alertManagerPort.description: AlertManager port to allow in the NetworkPolicy egress rule

cidr.description: CIDR for external webhook endpoints (Slack, PagerDuty, Teams)
CIDR for OCI container registry egress (datastorage bundle validation)

ingressNamespaces.description: Namespaces allowed to send ingress to Gateway (e.g., monitoring for AlertManager)

kubernautAgent.description: NetworkPolicy ingress-source config for Kubernaut Agent (unconditionally mandatory -- DD-PLATFORM-006 DA3)

apifrontend.description: BR-PLATFORM-005: NetworkPolicy ingress-source config for APIFrontend (unconditionally mandatory when apifrontend.enabled -- DD-PLATFORM-006 DA3)

ingressNamespaces.description: Namespaces allowed to send ingress to APIFrontend (e.g., an ingress-controller namespace)

console.description: BR-PLATFORM-006: NetworkPolicy ingress-source config for the web console. A no-op when console.enabled=false (unconditionally mandatory otherwise -- DD-PLATFORM-006 DA3).

ingressNamespaces.description: Namespaces allowed to send ingress to the console (e.g., an ingress-controller namespace)

idp.description: Egress target for the OIDC identity provider that Console/APIFrontend authenticate against (token exchange, JWKS discovery). Defaults to "anywhere on 443" for a real external IDP; override for an in-cluster or non-standard-port IDP (e.g. a test-only OIDC provider double).

extraPorts.description: Additional IdP ports to open egress on against the same cidr, for deployments where one service must reach two different IdPs on two different ports.

llm.description: Egress target for the LLM provider APIFrontend's A2A launcher agent calls directly (apifrontend.config.agent.llm.endpoint -- mandatory AF config, so this egress rule is unconditional on the AF NetworkPolicy). Defaults to "anywhere on 443" for a real external LLM provider; override for an in-cluster or non-standard-port LLM (e.g. a test-only mock-LLM double).

mcpGateway.description: Egress target for the MCP Gateway (global.fleet.mcpGatewayEndpoint) that every fleet-aware service's resilient MCP client connects to directly. Defaults to "anywhere on 8080" -- both supported gateway variants (Kuadrant's mcp-gateway-istio and Envoy AI Gateway) listen on 8080 and commonly live in a different namespace than the calling pod, or are genuinely external in a real deployment; override for a non-standard-port MCP Gateway.
